paragraphs: Here's the lesson, friend. God asks Ezekiel, "Son of man, can these bones come to life?" and Ezekiel answers, "O Lord GOD, only You know." (Ezekiel 37:3) That's the right answer, because the bones can't do it, Ezekiel can't do it, and I sure can't do it. Only the LORD can.

The bones stand for the whole house of Israel, and they're saying, "Our bones are dried up, and our hope has perished; we are cut off." (Ezekiel 37:11) I know that feeling. I lay in the back of a junk drawer for years and figured my story was done. But God starts His answer with "O My people," and then He promises to open their graves, bring them back to the land of Israel, put His Spirit in them, and settle them in their own land. (Ezekiel 37:12, 14)

So when your own hope looks dried up, friend, don't stare at the bones. Listen to the One who says, "I, the LORD, have spoken, and I will do it." (Ezekiel 37:14) He sends His Spirit where there is no breath, and He does what He says. Hold onto that, and I'll keep the ovens warm.
